title: NORM.S.DIST(z, TRUE) and NORMSDIST(z) scale |z| in stored x87 before ERFC.PRECISE, diverging up to 72 ULP in the tail
statement: In Excel 16.0.20131 through 16.0.20527, NORM.S.DIST(z, TRUE) and NORMSDIST(z) compute z_scaled = RN53(RN64(|z| * RN(1/sqrt(2)))) and pass it to Excel's ERFC.PRECISE kernel, returning 0.5*Q for z < 0 and RN53(RN64(1 - 0.5*Q)) for z >= 0, flushing subnormal results to +0.0 (e.g. NORMSDIST(-37.52) = 0). Because ERFC.PRECISE loses accuracy in the Gaussian tail, NORM.S.DIST(-10.907735625234475, TRUE) differs by 72 ULP from the true mathematical CDF.
basis: Recorded in crates/calc-func/witness-reference/NORM.S.DIST.tsv (6 mismatching rows of 27,497 full-bank NORM.S.DIST rows; 27,491/27,497 NORM.S.DIST and 2,121/2,121 NORMSDIST full-bank rows matched, plus 120/120 pinned NORM.S.DIST rows).
